subject: Ponds lens: Roberts Eros Ponds Catalog V1.1 centres registered to the Gaskell ver128q shape

revision.note: Uncommitted on feat/even-more-data. Uses the draft circle-catalogue reader (output/eros-even-more/drafts/packages/bake/src/objects/raster/circle-catalogue.ts), run by output/eros-even-more/ponds-preview.mts; no bake.

environment: Node 24.21.0 with the worktree's built @cssearth/bake (loadPdsVertexFacetShape, closestPoint, paintScienceSurface, renderRadialSnapshot).
labelCheck: The PDS4 label's file name, 334 records, CRLF and comma delimiters and the eight field names and units equal the recipe.

rowConsistency.method: Latitude, east longitude and distance recomputed from X, Y, Z (km) and compared with the printed columns.

centreRegistration.method: Closest point of the full ver128q mesh (196,608 facets) to each catalogued centre; the 60 m limit was chosen before measuring as a little under half the 131.9 m median ver128q edge (measured afterwards over all 589,824 edges).
centreRegistration.note: The withheld centres are 66 to 384 m from the ver128q surface, while the other 326 are within 27.4 m. Whether they sit on a different Gaskell model was not checked; they are withheld, not moved. Three withheld centres (1, 2 and 255) are only 6 to 9 m past the limit.

flatPreview.note: Withheld pixels are radial rays that meet the surface more than once.

limits: Registration is to the shape, not to the MSI photographs: the lens drawn over the 550 nm Golish map was inspected, but at 10 m pixels most ponds are not separately visible, so no image-to-catalogue offset is claimed. No bake or browser check has been run.
